newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA SAYS NO PLANS TO CHANGE 394 TONNE GOLD RESERVES.
newsitem.headline: CHINA SAYS NO PLANS TO CHANGE 394 TONNE GOLD RESERVES.

text.p: China has no plans to sell gold or to alter the size of its 394 tonne reserves because of the need to maintain a steady reserve, the China Daily Business Weekly on Sunday quoted a central bank official as saying.

"China is a developing country, so it must keep a stable gold reserve for emergency use and to keep a balance of international payment," it quoted the unidentified official of the People's Bank of China as saying.
China's gold reserves had been kept at about 394 tonnes for many years and would not change, she said.
